summary.zh-TW: 從右下角滑入的通知：新的會把舊的往上推，底部的細線顯示剩餘時間，時間到自動消失；滑鼠移上去會暫停。最多同時顯示三則。
summary.en: Notifications that slide in at the bottom right: new ones push older ones up, a thin line shows the time left, and they leave on their own — hovering pauses them. Up to three at once.

text.zh-TW: 通知外面多包一層，只動這層的高度。新通知撐開時，上面的通知會平順地被推上去，不會突然跳動。
text.en: Each toast has an outer wrapper whose height animates. As a new one opens up, the ones above are pushed smoothly instead of jumping.

text.zh-TW: 倒數本身就是一段 tween（細線從滿縮到 0），onComplete 時收掉通知。滑鼠移上去或鍵盤焦點在裡面時暫停，讓人有時間看完。
text.en: The countdown is itself a tween (the line shrinks to 0) that dismisses the toast on complete. It pauses on hover or keyboard focus so people have time to read.

text.zh-TW: 離場分兩步：先往右滑出淡出，再把高度收成 0。如果直接移除元素，下面的通知會瞬間跳上來。
text.en: Leaving takes two steps: slide out and fade to the right, then collapse the height to 0. Removing the element directly would make the others jump.

text.zh-TW: 同時太多通知會蓋住畫面。超過上限就先收掉最舊的一則。
text.en: Too many toasts at once cover the page. Over the limit, the oldest one is dismissed first.

text.zh-TW: 讀屏軟體會在使用者停下來時唸出新通知，不會打斷正在唸的內容。錯誤要立刻提醒的話可以改用 role="alert"。
text.en: Screen readers announce new toasts when the user pauses, without interrupting. For errors that need immediate attention, use role="alert" instead.
